summary: Lesson 4 (Jihad) taught jihad and then all three festivals in full, duplicating lesson 5. The whole festivals section is removed from content_html and replaced by one signpost paragraph; the description, exam tip, both festival takeaways, three practice questions, four knowledge checks, two flashcards and the five festival glossary terms are re-pointed at jihad only. Counts hold at 6 practice / 5 knowledge checks (2 mcq, 2 fill, 1 match, all canonical shape) / 15 flashcards, and the retained content keeps 2 key facts, 2 collapsibles and 4 dfn terms matching 4 glossary terms. FOLLOW-UP REQUIRED after applying: lesson 4 must be re-narrated and its narration_manifest pruned - clips n17-n25 (238.7s of festivals audio) become orphans that the whole-lesson player would still play, and n16, n29 and n30 now carry new text. _renarrate_from_backup.py refreshes changed and new ids but does NOT delete orphaned manifest entries. Also note the trim leaves content_html at 609 words against 848-1137 in the sibling lessons; adding jihad depth (for example a section on misuse of the term) is a content build, not part of this trim.
